# SalesMail Launches Sidekick

New AI Coaching and Tour Intelligence platform helps portfolio leaders benchmark performance, spot systemic issues, improve follow-up, and connect coaching investments to occupancy outcomes

**TL;DR**

- **Sidekick Launches for Senior Living**: SalesMail introduced Sidekick, an AI-powered coaching and tour intelligence platform built specifically for senior living sales and leasing teams.
- **Automate Tour-to-Follow-Up Workflow**: Sidekick audio-records in-person tours, transcribes conversations, generates CRM notes, and drafts personalized follow-up video messages through SalesMail's core platform.
- **Get Personalized Coaching**: Sidekick compares each tour against an organization's own sales standards to generate individualized coaching recommendations for every sales counselor.
- **Benchmark Performance Across Communities**: Portfolio and multi-location operators can use Sidekick to compare communities, spot performance patterns, and correlate tour quality with occupancy outcomes.
- **Built for Senior Living, Not Generic Video Tools**: Sidekick is an AI tour intelligence and coaching platform — not a video conferencing or transcription tool — purpose-built for senior living sales and leasing teams; request access at [salesmail.com/sidekick](http://salesmail.com/sidekick).

# **SalesMail Launches Sidekick, a New AI Coaching and Tour Intelligence Platform for Senior Living**

### **New AI Coaching and Tour Intelligence platform helps portfolio leaders benchmark performance, spot systemic issues, improve follow-up, and connect coaching investments to occupancy outcomes**

_Daphne, AL - September 16, 2026_\-\- [**SalesMail**](https://www.salesmail.com/), a leading platform for [**personalized video outreach**](https://www.salesmail.com/personalized-video) trusted by organizations across senior living, home care, and beyond since 2019, today announced the launch of [**SalesMail Sidekick**](https://www.salesmail.com/sidekick), a new AI Coaching and Tour Intelligence platform purpose-built for senior living.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669572/6aea5f6af5610cbd41c4bf13_Sidekick%20Value%20Prop%20for%20PR.png)

[**Sidekick**](https://www.salesmail.com/sidekick) is a standalone product that works alongside the [**SalesMail video platform**](https://www.salesmail.com/personalized-video) sales teams already use.

For leaders overseeing a senior living portfolio, the in-person tour has always been the hardest part of the business to see clearly. On-site sales directors debrief informally, notes make it into the CRM inconsistently, and by the time results show up in occupancy numbers, the window to course-correct has often closed.

For sales directors, documenting the tour can also mean dividing their attention between building a relationship with the prospect and trying to capture the details of the conversation, then spending additional time afterward reconstructing the tour and entering it into the CRM.

Sidekick solves that challenge and frees the sales director to focus on relationship-building.

The platform listens to and records every in-person tour, automatically captures the conversation and creates detailed notes in the CRM. By eliminating the distraction of taking notes, Sidekick allows sales directors to stay fully present with the prospect, focusing their energy on building a relationship and understanding a family’s needs rather than documenting the conversation.

Sidekick then generates personalized post-tour coaching for sales teams. Coaching is built on each organization's own sales rubric rather than generic standards.

To improve conversion metrics, Sidekick can be coupled tightly with SalesMail, drafting personalized SalesMail video follow-ups that reference the specific concerns and details each prospect shared on tour.

For leadership, Sidekick benchmarks every community side by side, surfacing performance gaps without requiring anyone to sit in on a tour. It identifies objection and sentiment patterns repeating across a portfolio, highlighting systemic issues worth solving at the leadership level rather than one conversation at a time.

Additionally, Sidekick correlates tour quality and follow-up behavior with actual conversion and occupancy outcomes, so leaders know which coaching investments are moving the business.

“For years, the in-person tour has been the most important part of our industry’s sales process, and the part leadership has had the least visibility into,” said Walt Armentrout, CEO and Co-Founder of SalesMail. “Sidekick changes that. It gives leaders a clear, consistent view into every tour across their portfolio, and it gives sales teams the coaching they need to make the next tour better than the last.”

“Sales directors shouldn't have to choose between being fully present with a prospect and capturing everything they need to remember from the conversation,” said Corey DeGeorge, COO of SalesMail.

“Sidekick takes that burden off their plate by automatically capturing the tour and documenting the details, so they can focus their full attention on building a relationship and understanding the prospect's needs. For regional and portfolio leaders, that same information is available without having to chase down notes or join tours, giving them more time to focus their coaching where it matters most.”

SalesMail will showcase Sidekick live at SMASH, taking place October 5-7, 2026 in Las Vegas. Conference attendees can see Sidekick in action at the SalesMail kiosk.

Senior living operators can learn more and request early access at [**salesmail.com/sidekick**](https://www.salesmail.com/sidekick).

**About SalesMail**

[**SalesMail**](https://www.salesmail.com/) is a leading platform for [**personalized video outreach**](https://www.salesmail.com/personalized-video), helping teams connect with prospects and customers through quick, authentic video communication that drives measurable results. Trusted by thousands of customers across senior living, home care, and adjacent markets, SalesMail combines ease of use, AI-assisted capabilities, and human-centered design to improve engagement, conversion, and customer experience. SalesMail's newest product, [**Sidekick**](https://www.salesmail.com/sidekick), extends that mission with AI-powered tour intelligence and coaching built specifically for senior living sales teams.

For more information, visit [**salesmail.com.**](https://www.salesmail.com/)
